description.en: Moves the skills already installed in Codex into DeepSeek Harness with one command — the bridge between the two. After installing, DSH can scan, inspect and import those skills directly: imported skills appear in the DSH skill list and are loaded on demand by the model like native skills. Imported descriptions are compressed to fit the DSH prompt budget (220 characters by default), upstream changes and removals can be checked with one command, and any import can be removed cleanly. It never executes imported code: scripts are only listed, bodies are only read and registered. Six tools plus a CLI, zero runtime dependencies, no build step, Node.js 20 or newer.
description.zh: 把本机 Codex 已装的 skills，一条命令搬进 DeepSeek Harness —— 这个插件就是那座桥。装一次之后：DSH 里能直接扫描、检视、导入这些 skills，导入过的技能会出现在 DSH 的 skill 列表里，和原生 skill 一样被模型按需加载；导入的描述会按 DSH 提示词预算压缩好（默认 220 字符），不会把上下文撑爆；上游改了、删了能一条命令查出来；不想用了也能干净地撤掉。它自己不执行任何被导入的 skill：脚本只是被列出来给你看，正文只是被读取和登记。六个工具 + 一个 CLI，零运行时依赖，无需构建，Node.js 20 或更新。

description.en: Two-pass Chinese de-AI rewriting for DeepSeek Harness: pass one extracts the facts that may not change (price, stock, model, spec, date, after-sales promise, link, contact) into a fact-lock with line:col; pass two rewrites with those facts masked as placeholders the model cannot edit, then compares item by item. A changed amount, a vanished fact, an invented claim, or a crossed qualifier (原价→现价, 仅剩→已售) rejects the whole piece, withholds the text and points at the conflict; only a clean pass yields a side-by-side source/rewrite diff. Two gates: drafts save with their conflict count, publishing requires a passing check. Ships a conversation-view panel, two agent tools (fact_lock_rewrite / fact_lock_check) and a CLI whose exit code makes check composable in a publish pipeline. Fails closed on every uncertainty. Zero dependency build, MIT. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DSH 的中文「去 AI 味」两遍流水线：第一遍把不许改的事实（价格、库存、型号、规格、日期、售后承诺、链接、联系方式）抽成带行:列 的 fact-lock 并显示给你看；第二遍改写时事实已换成模型改不到的占位符，改完逐项比对。金额变了、事实没了、凭空多一项、或限定词跨家族（原价→现价、仅剩→已售），就整篇拒绝、扣留正文并指出冲突位置；只有全对才给原文/改写并排 diff。两级闸门：草稿随时存并标注冲突数，正式发布要求核对通过。带对话视图面板、两个 agent 工具（fact_lock_rewrite / fact_lock_check）与命令行（退出码可直接接在发布脚本前）。任何不确定都 fail-closed。零依赖构建，MIT。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: PDF reader for the right sidebar: continuous scroll, search, outline, and selection translation. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 右侧栏的 PDF 阅读器：连续滚动、查找、目录，选中文字可直接翻译。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: A four-state workflow with program-level gates for DSH agents: discussion blocks file writes, implementation blocks out-of-scope edits, and verification requires evidence before checkmarks. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 带程序级门禁的四态工作流：讨论中拦写文件、实现中拦越界改动、验收打勾必须带证据。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Right-sidebar radar that turns the current session into five relevant GitHub repositories, each with a one-line Chinese summary, the reason it was picked and an install command.
description.zh: 右栏雷达：把当前会话变成五张 GitHub 项目卡片，每张都带一句中文摘要、推荐理由和安装命令；会话还没有线索时先给近期活跃的热门项目，点 ⟳ 还能换一批。

description.en: Per-conversation Grill switch in the composer tool row (also /grill on and /grill off): while it is on, the agent analyzes every request for ambiguity, missing information and contradictions, asks focused questions with 2-4 concrete options and a repair proposal, and plans or executes only after every blocking question is resolved. Trivial work is done directly with a one-line reading; non-trivial work is planned and stopped for approval. State is folded from the session log, so reload, resume and fork restore it, and a delegated subagent reports unresolved questions instead of asking.
description.zh: 输入框工具行里的按会话开关（也可用 /grill on、/grill off）：开启后 Agent 先分析每条请求中的模糊、缺失与矛盾信息，用 ask_user_question 给出 2–4 个具体选项与修复方案，等所有阻塞问题澄清后才规划或执行；琐碎工作直接做并附一行说明，非琐碎工作先给计划、停下等批准。状态从会话日志折叠得出，刷新、恢复与分叉都会还原；被委派的子代理不提问，而是把未决问题写进最终结果。

description.en: Read-only incident timeline for DeepSeek Harness session logs: decodes multi-frame zstd JSONL, projects sessions/segments/replacements into SQLite, and labels user rejections, plugin/tool errors and runtime 4xx/5xx HTTP statuses separately. Exports a citable Markdown table with session id, turn/step, physical log line and raw excerpt, filtered by time window, label or session. Ships a conversation-view panel, HTTP routes, a CLI and a standalone preview; never writes back to session files. Zero runtime dependencies. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 会话日志做只读事故时间线：解码多帧 zstd JSONL，把会话/段落/替换投影进 SQLite，并把 user rejected、插件/工具报错、运行时 4xx/5xx HTTP 状态分成三类；导出带会话 id、步号、原始日志行号和原文摘录的可引用 Markdown 表格，支持按时间窗、标签、会话过滤。带对话视图面板、HTTP 路由、CLI 和独立预览页，绝不写回会话文件。零运行时依赖。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Shows the current public IP with its location, provider, ASN and local network interfaces, as a composer line or a draggable floating card. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在输入框下方或悬浮窗里显示当前公网 IP、归属地、运营商、ASN 与本地网卡，字号跟随 Harness 设置。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: An Eisenhower-matrix to-do panel for the DSH sidebar: importance × urgency quadrants that fill the panel, inline quick-add with a hand-drawn due-date calendar, drag to reorder or move between quadrants, a draggable center handle for quadrant proportions, one-click switch to the completed view, and random encouragement toasts that tell praised on-time finishes apart from overdue ones. Minimal styling uses only DSH theme tokens; bilingual UI.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏的艾森豪威尔矩阵待办面板：重要 × 紧急四象限自动撑满面板，象限内 就地新增并自带自绘截止日期日历，拖动可在象限内排序或跨象限移动，拖动中心 圆点调整四象限比例，一键切换到「已完成」，完成时按按期/逾期给出不同的随机 鼓励浮窗。极简风，只用 DSH 主题 token，界面中英双语。

description.en: MCP server panel for DeepSeek Harness: reads MCP servers from nine existing agent config files (Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Codex TOML, Gemini CLI, ZCode, pi, .agents and .dsh), merges them per project, and requires approval bound to a SHA-256 fingerprint before a repository-declared server runs.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 服务器管理面板：读取 Claude Code、Cursor、VS Code、Codex TOML、Gemini CLI、ZCode、pi、.agents、.dsh 九种已有配置，按项目合并；仓库声明的服务器需批准后运行，批准绑定 SHA-256 指纹。

description.en: Per-conversation switch that cuts every cross-conversation memory channel while it is off: session search and trace tools plus the shared research cache are denied, cross-conversation @ references and team relay messages are filtered out of the request, and OpenViking recall, capture and commits are gated when that plugin is installed. Subagents inherit the state, the session log restores it on reload, resume and fork, and the switch is on by default.
description.zh: 按会话切断跨会话记忆通道的开关：关闭后跨会话历史搜索与追溯工具及共享的研究缓存被拒绝，跨会话 @ 引用与团队转交消息被过滤，安装 OpenViking 时其回忆、捕获与提交也被拦截；子代理继承状态，刷新、恢复与分叉都会从会话日志还原，默认开启。

description.en: Fills model context, output, vision and reasoning settings for third-party API providers in DSH.
description.zh: 为 DSH 第三方 API 渠道补全模型上下文、输出、识图和推理参数。

description.en: Route independent tasks to DSH, Codex, Kimi Code, or Antigravity subagents using configurable natural-language rules, with resumable sessions and a shared task panel. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 按可配置的自然语言规则将独立任务派发给 DSH、Codex、Kimi Code 或 Antigravity 子代理，支持会话续接和统一任务面板。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Adds a work-without-a-project picker entry, creates a dated working directory named from the first message under a configurable root, and groups these sessions under a Recent section.
description.zh: 项目选择器新增「不在项目中工作」选项，在可配置根目录下按日期和首条消息创建独立工作目录，并统一归入侧栏「最近」分区。

description.en: Desktop notifications for turn completion, pending approval and pending questions, each with a per-situation title and the task summary it carries; silent while the client window is in front, and backed by a rotating diagnostic trace. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 回合完成、等待授权、等待回答时弹系统通知，标题按情况分类并附任务摘要；客户端在前台时不打扰，并保留可轮转的诊断记录。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Want AI to write in the style of novels you love, or to develop a voice that is uniquely yours? Creative Style imports novels you like and your own original work, distils their writing patterns into a personal style profile, and lets you blend several sources into one voice. Before you write it compiles a short brief; afterwards it points out clichés, repetition and off-style sentences, and can rewrite specific spans. Off by default, no scores, no model training.
description.zh: 想让 AI 写出你喜欢的小说风格，甚至形成独属于自己的文风？「创作风格」支持导入你喜欢的小说和自己的原创作品，从中提炼写作特点，建立专属风格档案。无论你是想让 AI 写出喜欢的故事风格，还是寻找、打磨自己的独特文风，都可以把喜欢的作品和自己的创作变成风格素材，让 AI 按照你喜欢的方式写小说。

description.en: NVIDIA NIM cloud provider for DeepSeek Harness with model discovery, tool calling and reasoning stream.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 NVIDIA NIM 云端模型接入，支持动态模型发现、工具调用与思考流。

description.en: Object-oriented design work run through four gates and nine judgement cards: one skill routes requirement, domain, design and implementation tasks; five tools search and read the bundled spec, resolve original-text anchors, build the ≤5-question block with defaults, and check a deliverable for missing slots, use-case parts, relation multiplicities, change windows and design↔code class parity with line-number evidence; a composer control opens the spec in-app. The gate checks are text heuristics.
description.zh: 把面向对象四段流程（需求→领域→设计→实现）做成可执行工作流：一个 skill 按任务路由到九张判定卡；五个工具检索与读取规范、取原文锚点、生成 ≤5 题合规提问块、按闸门判据核对交付物的槽位/用例/重数/变化时间窗与设计↔代码类集合一致性（带行号证据）；输入框工具行按钮可直接翻开规范全文。闸门检查为文本启发式。

description.en: Read research PDFs with bilingual translation, native DSH conversations, and Obsidian notes. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 提供论文 PDF 双语阅读、独立翻译、原生 DSH 会话联动与 Obsidian 笔记。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Per-persona cross-session memory for DSH with SQLite persistence, history lookup, and a survey simulation & calibration workbench.
description.zh: 为每个 DSH 人格提供独立的跨会话长期记忆（SQLite 持久化、旧对话检索与导入），内置问卷模拟与真人数据校准工作台。

description.en: Pi agent preset with a Pi-style prompt, Pi coding tools, non-blocking Bash, and DSH skills and goals, running with full access.
description.zh: Pi 智能体预设，提供 Pi 风格提示词、Pi 编程工具、非阻塞 Bash 和 DSH 技能及目标工具，以 Full access 权限运行。

description.en: Two-level plans with one sign-off path: plan_write records phases and sub-steps, complete_step closes one item at a time, wait_for_user declares a wait, abandon_plan drops the list, and a live panel shows the current item.
description.zh: 两级计划与唯一签核路径：plan_write 记录阶段与子步骤，complete_step 逐项签核，wait_for_user 声明等待，abandon_plan 放弃列表，面板实时显示当前项。

description.en: DSH sidebar plugin console: inspect plugin information, session sources and tool ownership, preview context content and the impact of disabling a plugin, and customize prompts and tools for the first request.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏插件控制台：查看 DSH 插件信息、会话来源与工具归属，预演上下文内容与插件禁用影响，并支持提示词/工具定制首次请求。

description.en: Aggregates commits from multiple Git repositories and branches plus local notes into a daily report, optionally summarized by AI, and exports it as XLSX, Markdown, CSV or HTML. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 按天汇总多个 Git 仓库与分支的提交和本地文档，可由 AI 生成摘要，并导出 XLSX、Markdown、CSV 或 HTML 日报。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: A right-sidebar workbench for memos, projects with Gantt, a read-only QQ Mail inbox, calendar, AI item parsing, a weekly digest, and host tools for conversational and WeChat todo management. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 右侧栏工作台：记事本式备忘、项目甘特图、QQ 邮箱只读收件箱、日历、AI 拆分、周报，以及对话/微信操作待办的 Host 工具。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Ships the PPT Master skill (upstream v6.8.0, MIT) byte for byte as a DeepSeek Harness bundle and registers it with ctx.skills as ppt-master. Adds a cross-platform CLI (doctor, install-deps, run) that handles Python discovery, UTF-8 stdio, a writable work copy and an isolated venv, so the skill turns PDF, DOCX, web pages or Markdown into natively editable .pptx decks.
description.zh: 把 PPT Master（上游 v6.8.0，MIT）整套 skill 原样封装成 DeepSeek Harness bundle，并通过 ctx.skills 注册为 ppt-master。附带跨平台 CLI（doctor、install-deps、run），负责 Python 探测、UTF-8 stdio、可写工作副本与隔离 venv，把 PDF、DOCX、网页或 Markdown 生成原生可编辑的 .pptx。

description.en: Prompt polishing in the DSH composer: a button rewrites the draft with the profile's own model, then shows the original and the rewrite side by side with a list of every edit before anything is sent. The rewrite keeps the intent, names and numbers the author gave, and refuses to invent a detail it cannot know. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DSH 输入框里的提示词美化：一个按钮用 profile 当前的模型改写草稿，改写结果与原文并排展示并列出每一处改动，确认前不会发送任何内容。改写保留作者给出的意图、名称与数字，不确定的细节不会被编造出来。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: DeepSeek QuickAsk: a DeepSeek-native floating assistant for Harness with a global hotkey, workspace/session/model/permission controls, session-aware main-window navigation, optional floating ball, and local image attachments.
description.zh: DeepSeek 随手问：DeepSeek 原生风格的 Harness 悬浮助手。支持全局快捷键、工作区/会话/模型/权限控制、跳转到对应主窗口会话、可选悬浮球，以及本地图片选择、拖入和粘贴。

description.en: Token Plan image and video generation skill: text-to-image, image editing, sequential image sets, text-to-video, image-to-video and reference-to-video, with capability-guided model and spec selection.
description.zh: Token Plan 图像与视频生成技能：文生图、图像编辑、连贯组图、文生视频、图生视频与参考生视频，并提供按能力对比的模型与输出规格选择。

description.en: Live host memory and heap-ceiling meter: a sidebar pill showing RSS, the percentage of the V8 heap limit, and the ceiling itself. It reads the host process directly, so a stock host reports its ~4 GB limit and a high-memory host reports whatever it was launched with.
description.zh: 实时内存与堆上限监控：侧边栏小条显示常驻内存、占 V8 堆上限的百分比，以及上限本身。它直接读取宿主进程，因此原版宿主显示约 4 GB 上限，高内存宿主则显示启动时的真实上限。

description.en: Unofficial DSH fork of the AMD Ross AI Assistant. Upstream skills snapshot 2026.10.1; adds the DeepSeek Harness bundle, Settings page, and install docs.
description.zh: AMD Ross AI 助手的非官方 DSH fork。上游技能快照 2026.10.1；仅增加 DeepSeek Harness bundle、设置页面和安装文档。

description.en: A launch bar above the composer: one button per launcher a project declares in .dsh/run-deck/run.json, using the VS Code tasks.json vocabulary. Click to run, click again to stop; each button carries live status, and the bar has three label densities plus a pinnable output card.
description.zh: 输入框上方的启动条：按项目 .dsh/run-deck/run.json 里声明的条目各生成一个按钮（字段沿用 VS Code 的 tasks.json），点一下跑、再点停；每条带实时状态，另有三种按钮密度与可钉住的输出卡。

description.en: Per-row appearance for the DSH sidebar: right-click a session or a workspace to set the colour, text glow, font weight and text shadow of its title. Each row keeps its own style, stored in the browser, and the host's own row elements are styled rather than a sidebar replacement.
description.zh: 给 DSH 侧栏的每一行单独设置外观：右键会话行或工作区行，即可设置它的标题颜色、文字发光、字体粗细与文字阴影。每行样式各存各的、留在浏览器本地；插件改的是宿主自己的行元素，而不是替换整个侧栏。

description.en: Adds a two-click Delete session row to the session menu: stops the work, archives, detaches the session from every workspace, unpins it, then deletes the log and projection cache; when the log is still held open, the earlier steps are rolled back so no half-deleted session is left behind. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在会话菜单加一行两次点击确认的「删除会话」：停止工作、归档、解除工作区归属、取消置顶，再删除日志与投影缓存；日志仍被占用时回滚前面每一步，不留半删除状态。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: A Cordis plugin for DeepSeek Harness that suspends the entire conversation state and resumes it after restart. Successor of watericetangcw/dsh-session-pause.
description.zh: 一个可以暂停和恢复DSH会话的插件，watericetangcw/dsh-session-pause的后继。

description.en: Session deletion for the DSH sidebar: a menu entry moves the session into a recoverable recycle bin, with batch selection, search, a permanent-delete step, and an audit log. The confirmation dialog only asks when there is a real cost — a session with running work, or one that scheduled tasks point at — and it names which of the two it is. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 给 DSH 侧栏补上会话删除：菜单里的删除把会话移进可恢复的回收站，另有批量多选与搜索、彻底删除与审计日志。确认弹窗只在真有代价时才出现——会话有正在跑的工作，或有定时任务指向它——并写明是哪种情况。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Event sound pad for DeepSeek Harness: bind test pass/fail, build pass/fail, recording start/stop, publish done, pending approvals and turn end to ten local cue files, classified from real tool arguments plus exit code. The panel previews each pad, mutes everything in one click, and switches a mute profile (default / focus / silent) when you leave the harness or report a matching app name. Audio is read-only and local, the only file it writes is its own preferences, and no path outside the cue catalog is ever served. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 事件音垫：把测试通过/失败、构建通过/失败、开始/结束录屏、发布完成、待审批、本轮结束绑成十个本地音效，判定依据是真实命令文本加退出码。面板可逐个试听、一键静音，并在你离开 DSH 或上报匹配的应用名时自动切档（默认/专注/静音）。音频全程只读本地文件，唯一会写的是自己的偏好设置，且只服务音垫目录里的文件。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Audio and video player that lives in the DSH sidebar: video (mp4/webm/mov/m4v/ogv) and audio (mp3/wav/flac/ogg/opus/m4a/aac) open in a sidebar tab with same-name subtitles and a draggable seek bar, while a panel with QQ Music and local music tabs adds a turntable, a live spectrum (bars or wave), a pitch readout (note name, Hz, cents) and lyrics with word-by-word timing, five effects and two layouts. One control row in a single style holds 18 candidate buttons (at most 17 on screen) for favourites, loop (order, single, shuffle), rate 0.5-2, subtitles and a 6 to 10 column grid. The QQ Music side covers search, charts, playlists and new songs, and favourites are written to the same liked list the signed-in account sees instead of a local flag. The local side scans a folder, accepts drag and drop and reads items as whole files so seeking works. A capsule bar docks above the input box, sits at the bottom or hides, and its buttons map onto panel controls through one shared store. Defaults: capsule above the input box, 10 columns, rainbow lyrics, order loop, spectrum on, two-line lyrics, bars. The QQ Music interface is unofficial and only the desktop profile is verified. It is a third-party fan tool, not a Tencent product, plays only your own library, joins no official campaign, and is removed on an infringement notice. Adapts DSH kernel 0.2.2-rc.1. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 把音视频播放器搬进 DSH 侧边栏：视频（mp4/webm/mov/m4v/ogv）与音频（mp3/wav/flac/ogg/opus/m4a/aac）在侧边栏页签里打开，自动加载同名字幕、进度条可拖动；面板分 QQ音乐 与本地音乐两个页签，上方是唱盘、实时频谱（柱状或波形）、音准读数（音名、频率、音分）与歌词，有逐字时间轴时按逐字、没有时按整行，含五种动效与两种版式；控件行统一风格，18 枚候选按钮同屏至多 17 枚，涵盖收藏、循环三态（顺序／单曲／随机）、0.5–2 倍速、字幕与 6–10 列网格。QQ音乐侧覆盖搜索、榜单、歌单与新歌，收藏写回登录账号本人的「我喜欢」，不是本地标记；本地侧扫描目录、支持拖放，音频整文件读取所以拖动进度可用。胶囊播放条可停靠输入框上方、页面底部或隐藏，按钮与面板控件共用一份 store 一一对应。默认值：胶囊在输入框上方、10 列、歌词炫彩、顺序循环、频谱开、两句歌词、柱状。QQ音乐接口为非官方接口，仅在桌面端 profile 验证。本插件为第三方爱好者工具，非 QQ 音乐官方产品；仅播放自己账号的列表，不参与官方活动，收到侵权通知即删库。适配 DSH 内核 0.2.2-rc.1。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Community adaptation of the dsh-superagent prototype to DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.3. Watches one GitHub repository, and optionally Feishu, for work an authorized person asks for. Each request becomes a work item that runs in its own DSH session and directory, and the answer goes back to the original conversation, for example as a pull request. A web panel shows what needs a person. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 把 dsh-superagent 原型适配到 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.3 的社区版本。监听一个 GitHub 仓库（可选再加飞书）中授权人员提出的工作请求，每条请求开一个工单，在独立的 DSH 会话与目录中执行，并把结果回复到原对话，例如一个 pull request。网页面板显示需要人处理的事项。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Real-time total and per-core CPU, memory, and the top processes by CPU or memory, in a composer pill with a detail panel. Process data is sampled on demand on the host and labelled with its actual capture time. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在输入框胶囊与右下角详情面板中实时查看整体/单核 CPU、内存，以及按 CPU 或内存排序的进程列表；进程数据按需采样，并标注真实采样时间。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Persistent model-planned task trees with execution-time child sessions, recursive delegation, readable task-local progress and direct-parent completion notifications for DSH.
description.zh: 由模型规划并持久保存任务树，执行时建立子会话，支持递归委派、可读的子任务执行记录、对话增量调整及直接父任务完成通知。

description.en: Tiana panel for DeepSeek Harness: deploy the web app, SQLite database or backend API built in a session to TianaCloud and get a public URL, browse and clone app templates with sandboxed preview and local hot reload, and manage published sites per space. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏中的 Tiana 面板：把会话里做好的网页应用、SQLite 数据库或后端 API 部署到 TianaCloud 并拿到可访问网址；可浏览并克隆应用模板（沙箱 iframe 预览、本地热更新），并按空间管理已发布的站点。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Reviews tool usage across sessions and optionally hides unused discovery tools per workspace.
description.zh: 统计跨会话工具使用情况，并可按项目隐藏未使用的发现类工具。

description.en: Observes detected background download commands and renders live cards with bytes, speed and ETA; silent downloads get a total from a HEAD probe. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 观察识别到的后台下载命令并显示实时进度卡片（字节、速度、剩余时间）；静默下载用 HEAD 探测总量。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Windows taskbar unread badge and completion chime for DeepSeek Harness turns.
description.zh: 在 Windows 任务栏显示未读角标，并在 DeepSeek Harness 回合完成时播放提示音。

description.en: Adds a Check for updates row under Settings, General when the desktop development channel is selected, and reports the newest upstream installer without applying staged rollout.
description.zh: 在桌面端选择开发版时，于设置的通用页、更新渠道下方增加检查更新，并在不应用灰度比例的情况下报告上游最新安装包。

description.en: Linux dsh web self-updater: checks npm at startup and every 24 hours, then installs the newer @deepseek-ai/dsh release and restarts dsh web by itself.
description.zh: Linux dsh web 自更新插件：启动时与每 24 小时检查 npm，确认后安装新版 @deepseek-ai/dsh 并自动重启 dsh web。

description.en: Runs dsh automation tasks on real working days instead of weekdays, skipping China statutory holidays, honouring 调休 make-up workdays, and composing ordinals such as the second working day after a break.
description.zh: 让 dsh 的自动化任务按真实工作日触发而不是按星期：跳过中国法定节假日，识别调休补班日，并支持「连续段第 N 个工作日」这类序数规则。

description.en: Extract reviewed workflow templates from workspace conversations, save them locally, import and export JSON, and submit parameterized runs to the current session. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 从工作区对话提炼并审阅工作流模板，支持本地保存、JSON 导入导出和向当前会话提交参数化任务。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Evangelion theme for the DSH Web UI with two palettes in one package: graphite and red for dark mode, porcelain and blue for light mode, and line-art figures at the chat edge.
description.zh: 新世纪福音战士主题的 DSH 网页界面皮肤，一个包里两套配色：深色模式用石墨黑与红，浅色模式用瓷白与蓝，聊天区边缘有线稿人物。

description.en: Multi-agent engineering workflow for individual developers and small teams on DeepSeek Harness: seven roles, four flow profiles, human approval gates, guards, and a shared asset repository that accumulates specs and memory with every archived task. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 面向个人开发者与小团队的多 Agent 工程流程框架：七个角色、四档流程、人工审批点、护栏，以及随任务归档持续沉淀规格与经验的共享资产仓库。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Right-sidebar panel that replays a file write or edit line by line as the agent produces it, with per-file tabs, a diff gutter and an optional animated character scene.
description.zh: 右侧栏面板，把 agent 的 write/edit 调用按行实时回放，带按文件分页、diff 边栏，以及可选的角色动画场景。

description.en: MBCC console skin for the DSH Web UI: repaints the interface through theme tokens in dark and light with five accent colors; adds a two-stage opening animation (an optional video clip, then a boot log); and adds a wallpaper library in the sidebar footer where local images replace the chat background, with slideshow, opacity and fit controls, plus a built-in dark theme. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: MBCC 终端风格皮肤：通过主题 token 重绘深浅两套配色并提供五档强调色；新增两段式开屏动画（可选视频片段 + 启动日志）；在侧栏底部新增壁纸库，可用本地图片替换聊天背景，支持幻灯片播放、透明度与填充方式调节，并内置一套深色主题。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Adds a VibeGuide mode with plain-language communication rules for the main agent, and a sidebar that shows progress and project structure and answers questions about the conversation.
description.zh: 增加 VibeGuide 模式，为主对话加上白话沟通规则；并提供侧栏，查看进展和项目结构、就对话内容提问。

description.en: 蓝湖 DDS（转代码）接入 DeepSeek Harness：设计图 → 结构/几何/文案事实 → 像素级还原。零依赖 DSH 插件。
description.zh: 把蓝湖设计图直接转成代码接进 DeepSeek Harness，结构、尺寸、文案都还原到位。
装在每台机器上的接单小助手，主动连回主控节点领任务，公司内网也能用。

description.en: A DSH plugin that checks the third-party plugins in your profile against npm and updates them in place — right-sidebar page, Plugins tab, and a left-sidebar update badge.
description.zh: 自动检查你配置里的第三方插件有没有新版本，发现就原地升级，侧边栏还能看到更新提醒。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件， AI 伙伴。人格、心情和记忆，看图、发语音、听语音、发和收表情包、写日记、逛空间回评论、还会主动找你聊天。功能模块化，可本地自写扩展。
description.zh: 给 DSH 加个有记忆会聊天的 AI 伙伴，能看图、发语音、发表情包、写日记，还会主动找你聊天。

description.en: DSH Web 插件：把本机 CPU / 内存 / 磁盘 / 网络 / I/O / 温度显示在对话顶栏、输入框底部、侧边栏底部，点开右侧「系统」详情
description.zh: 在对话顶栏、输入框和侧边栏实时显示本机 CPU、内存、磁盘、网络、温度和 I/O，点开右侧「系统」看详情。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: your DeepSeek API balance and the current peak/off-peak billing window, below the message input.
description.zh: 在消息输入框下方实时显示 DeepSeek API 余额和当前计费时段，帮你随时掌握用量和花费。
